name: ChoiceChip
description: A material design chip that represents a single choice from a set. Useful for filter options, preferences, or selections.

properties.name: label
properties.description: The primary content of the chip, usually a Text widget.

properties.name: selected
properties.description: Whether this chip is currently selected.

properties.name: onSelected
properties.description: Called when the chip is tapped, providing the new selected state.

properties.name: avatar
properties.description: A widget to display before the label, often a CircleAvatar.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The chip's background color when not selected.

properties.name: selectedColor
properties.description: The chip's background color when selected.

properties.name: labelStyle
properties.description: The style to use for the label text.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: The shape of the chip, often a StadiumBorder or RoundedRectangleBorder.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip the chip's content if it overflows.
